s: puM, (nir + hana + GaY .) vAyvaBihatavAyuprapatanajanyaSabdaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “vAyunABihate vAyO gaganAcca patatyaDaH । pracaRqaGoranirGozo nirGAta iti kaTyate ॥” iti SabdamAlA ॥ api ca । “yadAntarIkze balavAn mAruto marutAhataH । patatyaDaH sa nirGAto jAyate vAyusamBavaH ॥” iti jyotizam ॥ (etasya lakzaRAdikaM yaTA, bfhatsaMhitAyAM 39 aDyAye । “pavanaH pavanABihato gaganAdavanO yadA samApatati । Bavati tadA nirGAtaH sa ca pApo dIptavihagarutaH ॥ arkodaye'DikaraRikanfpaDaniyoDANganAbaRigveSyAH । ApraharAMSe'jAvikamupahanyAcCUdrapOrAMSca ॥ AmaDyAhnAdrAjopasevino brAhmaRAMSca pIqayati । vESvajaladAMstftIye cOrAn prahare caturTe ca ॥ astaM yAte nIcAn praTame yAme nihanti SasyAni । rAtrO dvitIyayAme piSAcamaNGAnnipIqayati ॥ turagakariRastftIye vinihanyAdyAyinaScaturTe ca । BEravajarjaraSabde yAti yatastAM diSaM hanti ॥”)
v: pu॰ nir + hama--GaY । pavanAhatapavanasya gaganAdmUmO patayajanye SabdaBede tallakzaRAdikaM vf॰ saM॰ 39 a॰ uktaM yaTA “pavanaH evanABihato gaganAdavanO yadA samApatati । Bavati tadA nirGAtaH sa ca pApo dIptavihagarutaH । sarkodaye'DikaraRikanfpaDaniyoDANganAvaRigveSyAH । A praharAtso'jAvikamupahanyAcCUdrapOrAMSca । A maDyAhnAdrAjopasevino brAhmaRAMSca pIqayati । vESyajaladAMstftIye cOrAn prahare caturTe ca । astaM yAte nIcAn praTame yAme nihanti sasyAni । rAtrO dvitIyayAme piSAcasaNgAnnipIqayati । turanakariRastftIye vinihanyAdyAyinaScaturTe ca । BEravajarjaraSabdo yAti yatastAM diSaM hanti” । “nirGAte BUmicalane jyotizAYcopasarjane । etAnAkAlikAn vidyAdanaDyAyAnftAvapi” manuH । “nirGAtogrEH kuYjalInAn jiGAMsuH” raGuH । “ulkApAte ca nirGAta taTEvAkAlavarzaRe । Cidre sUrye vinirdizwe na kuryyAn maNgalakriyAmf” jyotizatattve gargaH ।
m: निर्-घात m. (fr. Caus. of √ हन्) removal, destruction, TS.; Āpast.
whirlwind, hurricane, thunderstorm, earthquake &c. (ifc. f(आ). ), Gaut.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
N. of a Dānava, Kathās.
निर्घात (fr. Caus.) See s.v.
a: निर्घातः — 1 Destruction. --2 A whirlwind, a violent gust of wind, hurricane. --3 The noise of contending winds (vapours?) &c. in the sky; निर्घातोग्रैः कुंजलीनाञ् जिघांसुर्ज्यानिर्घोषैः क्षोभयामास सिंहान् R. 9. 64; Ms. 1. 38, 4. 105, 7, Y. 1. 145; (वायुना निहतो वायुर्गगनाच्च पतत्यधः . प्रचंडघोरनिर्घोषो निर्घात इति कथ्यते ...) --4 An earthquake. --5 A thunderstroke. --6 A stroke in general; अहह दारुणो दैवनिर्घातः U. 2.

m: निर्-घात—दुःसह mfn. difficult to be destroyed or overcome (sorrow), Kathās.
निर्-घात—कर mfn. removing, destroying, Car.
निर्-घात—लक्षण n. N. of 60 Pariśiṣṭas of AV.

v: na॰ nir + hana--svArye Ric--BAve lyuw । muSrutokte yantranizyAdye kriyABede yantrakarmARi tu nirGAtanapUraRabanDanetyAdinA uddiSya nirGAtanaYca kaTaM kAryyaM tatrAha “uttuRqitaM CittvA nirGAtayet CedanIyasuKam । CedanoyamukzAnTapi kukzivakzaHkaRAvaNkzaRaparSukAntara patitAni ca hastaSakyaM yaTAmArgaM hastenEvApaharttuM prayateta । anuttuRqitaSalyAni CedanIyamuKAni ca । anirTAtyAni jAnIyAt BUbaSCedAmubanDataH” ।
m: निर्-˚घातन n. forcing out, bringing out, Suśr.
निर्-˚घातय Nom. P. ˚यति, to draw or force out, Suśr.; to cause to be destroyed or killed, MBh.
निर्-˚घात्य mfn. to be forced or brought out (अ-निर्घ्˚), Suśr.
निर्-घूरिणी f. a river, L. (prob. w.r. for निर्-झरिणी).

a: निर्घंटः --टं — 1 A vocabulary, collection of words. --2 A table of contents (सूचीपत्र).

s: puM, (nir + GaRwa dIptO + GaY .) nirGaRwanam । niGaRwuH । gaRasaMgrahaH । granTAnAM sUcIti KyAtaH । yaTA, -- “DanvantarIyamadanAdihalAyuDAdIn viSvaprakASyamarakozamaSezarAjAn । Alokya lokaviditAMSca vicintya SabdAn dravyABiDAnagaRasaMgraha eza sfzwaH ॥ nirddaSalakzaRaparIkzaRanirRayena nAnAviDOzaDavicAraparAyaRo yaH । so'DItya yat sakalamenamavEti sarvvaM tasmAdayaM jagati BAti niGaRwurAjaH ॥” iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: nir + Gawi--ac । 1 granDAnAM sUcIpatre 2 niGaRwO ca SabdArTaci॰ ।
m: निर्घण्ट, निर्घ˚ण्टु, निर्घ˚ण्टुक = (and prob. w.r. for) नि-घण्ट &c., collection of words, vocabulary.
निर्-घर्षण &c. See निर्-घृष्.
निर्-˚घर्षण n. rubbing, friction, Sāy.
निर्-˚घर्षणक mfn. fit for rubbing or cleaning the teeth, Hit.

m: निर्—घट n. a great fair, crowded market, free market
a place where there is no quay or steps, L.
निर्—घृणा, f. (in स-निर्-घृण), निर्—घृण—ता, f. (Bhartṛ.), or निर्—घृण—त्व, n. (MārkP.) pitilessness, cruelty.

m: निर्—घृण mf(आ)n. unmerciful, cruel, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
shameless, immodest, W.
निर्—घृणम् ind. cruelly, MBh.
निर्-√ घृष् P. -घर्षति (only ind.p. -घृष्य), to rub against or on (loc.), R.
निर्—घो˚षाक्षर-विमुक्त m. N. of a Samādhi.
निर्-घो˚षाक्षर-विमुक्त m. N. of a Samādhi, L.

m: निर्—घोष mf(आ)n. soundless, noiseless, MBh.
निर्-घोष m. (for 1. See p. 541, col. 1) (ifc. f(आ). ) sound, noise, rattling, tramping, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: निर्घोषः — 1 A sound in general; Ve. 4; R. 1. 36. --2 A loud noise, rattling, twanging &c. ज्यानिर्घोषैः क्षोभयामास सिंहान् R. 9. 64; भारतीनिर्घोषः U. 3.

m: निर्-घुष्ट mfn. (√ घुष्) sounded, resounded.
